feature: Add adminNotes field to Job/Booking model
description: Add support for admin notes field that allows admins to store additional notes about a job/booking that are only visible to admins

database.description: Optional field for admins to add notes about the job. Not visible to regular users.

GET /api/jobs/:id.note: Should return adminNotes if job exists

GET /api/admin/jobs/:id.note: Should return adminNotes for admin users

PATCH /api/admin/jobs/:id.action: Accept adminNotes in request body and update it
PATCH /api/admin/jobs/:id.validation: adminNotes should be a string, can be empty

sends.location: In the request body with all other job fields

implementationSteps: 1. Add adminNotes field to your Job/Booking schema/model (String, optional, default: empty string)
2. Update PATCH /api/admin/jobs/:id endpoint to accept adminNotes in request body and save it to database
3. Update GET /api/jobs/:id endpoint to include adminNotes in response
4. Update GET /api/admin/jobs/:id endpoint to include adminNotes in response
5. Ensure adminNotes is included when fetching job lists (if applicable)
